title: corpus-harvest timestamped segment (one JSONL line)
description: Per-item sidecar SEGMENTS/<item_id>.jsonl emitted by normalize.py BEFORE flattening to TXT. The citation validator string-matches quotes into these segments (via the shared prose normalizer) and attaches time ranges mechanically. The 12tone reference discarded timestamps; this sidecar is the new work that makes citations time-addressable.
